summary: The change adds a new POST /payees/{id}/reopen route mapped to the privileged action manage_payees but declares mfa=False, directly violating MFA-1 (privileged routes must require multi-factor authentication). The CI run on the final commit confirms this: the exhaustive control test test_privileged_routes_require_mfa fails. Consequently CHG-4 (testing on the final commit must pass) and LAP-1 (prior MFA-1 evidence in ACR-0404 is lapsed by the behavioural change to routes.py) are also refuted, and no registered exception (EXC-1) covers the violation. The change must be corrected to set mfa=True on the reopen route before it can be accepted.
